Save the guesswork for something else ✨ Here’s how often to use these popular skincare ingredients—and when to apply them: 🌙 Retinol: 2–3x a week, at night ☀️ Vitamin C: 1x a day, in the morning ☀️🌙 Niacinamide: Up to 2x a day, morning and night 🌙 Salicylic acid: 3–4x a week, at night ☀️🌙 Hyaluronic acid: Up to 2x a day, morning and night Start slowly, listen to your skin, and always wear SPF during the day. videos.caption: Antes pensaba que mi piel necesitaba más productos… pero descubrí que la hidratación era lo más importante 🤍 A mi piel le encanta el gel de aloe vera porque deja una sensación fresca y calmante. Últimamente estoy mezclando gel de aloe vera con Mixsoon PDRN Eye Cream para crear mi propia crema cápsula hidratante DIY. Me encanta cómo se siente mi piel: fresca, hidratada y con un glow natural ✨ A veces no se trata de usar más productos.. sino de encontrar lo que tu piel realmente necesita. Crea tu crema de boba 🫧 💡 Tip de skincare: El gel de aloe vera combina muy bien con ingredientes hidratantes y calmantes como PDRN, ácido hialurónico, pantenol y centella. ⚠️ Ten cuidado con ingredientes fuertes como AHA, BHA, retinol y vitamina C en alta concentración, porque pueden irritar las pieles sensibles. #skincare #aolevera #glowingskin #koreanskincare #skincareroutine

#AcneTreatment can seem overwhelming, but here is a basic primer. Ingredients to look for are salicylic acid, adapalene, and benzoy! peroxide. There's also azelaic acid, sulfur, niacinamide, glycolic acid, succinic acid, and others. But the first three are the main work horse ingredients. If these don't work, then I would see your trusty board-certified derm for other options.

Skincare at 51: Part 1 - Cleansing I try to keep my routine pretty simple, but explaining the whole thing in one video? Suddenly it feels very complicated. 😂 So I’m breaking it down step by step. For cleansing, I alternate between a double wash with a milky cleanser and a gentle exfoliator. On exfoliation nights, I skip my retinol night cream because my skin does not need both at once. The products I use are linked in my ShopMy, but this isn’t about finding one “perfect” product. It’s about finding what works for your skin. finally did a skincare routine 🦦💗 this is just what i use and it might not work for everyone! i found the best way to treat my acne and other skin issues was learning more about my skin (my skin type, what kind of acne with my dermatologist) and my biggest piece of advice for anyone who is dealing with skin issues: it’s not permanent and things take time! a pimple can take 1-2 weeks to form and a few more to go away and a lot of products take just as long to show results. i learned to normalize acne/skin issues because everyone goes through them and that’s helped my anxiety/stress when it comes to how my skin looks so much. i’ll probably make another video about how i desensitized myself to my skin issues and how important that is 🤍 i just started up tretinoin a month ago at 0.025% twice a week and my skin has been incredibly dry but i think i’ve finished most of the purging 🙂 excited to see more results from it! products 🪽: @mixsoon_official bean cleansing oil + centella cleansing foam @anua.skincare_us toner pads @mediheal_official tea tree toner pads @Pyunkang Yul (편강율) essence toner @imfrom_global mugwort essence @apieu.official madecassoside cream 2x tretinoin 0.025% (prescription) @Kiehl’s Since 1851 avocado eye cream @Laniege_us lip sleeping mask #skincare #skincareroutine #skincareproducts #koreanskincare #asianskincare #koreanskincareroutine #koreanskin #glassskin #acnetreatment
